nature: Numerical check of deterministic inequalities (Lemma 1, Corollary 1, Lemma 3 of the draft) on already-recorded stage-2 instances. Re-analysis only: fitted matrices were stored in stage 2 only as SHA-256, so they are regenerated with the identical code path and accepted only if the hash matches the recorded value. Not a new experiment; no new data distribution, no sweep.
reference_solution: W* = stage-2 pop_moment__pop_norm minimax solution of the same teacher (regenerated, hash-checked)
analysis_radius: B = max(||W_hat||_F, ||W*||_F), chosen a posteriori; the inequalities are deterministic, so they hold for any B covering both matrices
epsilon_opt: UB - LB of the W_hat fit on its fitted objective
pointwise_checks: per task k at W_hat and at W*: Lemma 1 (fixed normaliser) and Lemma 3 (estimated normaliser)
expected: every inequality holds (they are proved); any violation is reported as an implementation or derivation error, not tuned away

resource_caps.note: analysis budget for this task is 1200 CPU-s in total; about 100 CPU-s are reserved for exporter and other small analyses
